text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Apr ×, Noon | Wind: Fair "The Great Voyage 
Begins!" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is finally beginning. 
I'll record our voyage in this 
logbook—it's sure to be a long and merry 
one.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
What I'm aiming for is to build a "castle" 
where everyone can live having fun 
forever! To do that, I need "real 
power"—money.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm gonna win big in the 
Twinkle Series, make a name for myself, 
and steal the eyes of sponsors all over 
the world!"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The flag my friends made for me might be 
tattered, but to me, it's the absolute 
best. Come on, let's set sail from here!
